title: JELLORIO SIGNS WITH WARNER MUSIC CHINA, UNVEILING A BRAND NEW MUSICAL CHAPTER
summary: Warner Music China today officially announced the signing of JelloRio, the acclaimed. . .
body_markdown:
Warner Music China today officially announced the signing of JelloRio, the acclaimed singer-songwriter and rapper renowned for his distinctive melodic rap style. The strategic partnership encompasses new music creation, commercial opportunities, and broader artist development as both parties collaborate to push creative boundaries and unlock new growth opportunities.


As one of the most creative and influential young voices in the Chinese music scene, JelloRio has established a formidable presence through a series of breakout hits, including “Falling (星球坠落)” and “Coffee (咖啡)”, alongside a signature sound that bridges rap and melody. His signing with Warner Music China marks a significant new milestone in his career.


New music from JelloRio is already in development, with official releases scheduled to roll out later this year. To celebrate the announcement, Warner Music China has partnered with international fashion magazine *ARENA HOMME+* to unveil a teaser for JelloRio’s upcoming editorial spread. Blending new music with high-fashion visual storytelling, the collaboration establishes a premium, multi-dimensional aesthetic for this next phase of his career.


Under the partnership, Warner Music China will provide comprehensive support spanning A&R, music production, and global marketing. By leveraging its expansive platform and cross-industry network, Warner Music aims to elevate JelloRio’s artistic profile, commercial reach, and cultural influence, bringing a new generation of forward-thinking Chinese artistry to an even broader audience.
